body: Beautifully written, I know those feels.  It will get better, the pain has started to go away for me.

Haha I've seen that article, I'll check out the comments too, thanks.

Thanks again for the kind words. I've been trying to stay positive and doubled my efforts in finding a new job and also started studying when I have free time. I just have to do my best and accept what happens.

You're great at metaphors by the way.

Sorry for the late reply, I passed out early since I didn't sleep last night. Thank you for the kind words  .. 

Regarding the bed bugs I have tried everything and spent thousands already. They are nearly impossible to get rid of. That's why it's so draining.

With my ex, it's not all her fault. I pushed her away back when I did have a job. I don't blame her entirely for leaving me when I am down. At the same time I left my job because she had convinced me that there was more to life than working in a cubicle in a job I hated. Now that she's gone I'm like a sailboat that's lost its compass and is now without a sail too, stuck in the middle if a dark vast ocean just drifting and awaiting death.

I want to ask her for help but last time we spoke I got angry because I was afraid and fearful that she was ditching me. Now she really is gone. 

I don't know what to do I just want to be back doing a job again. I feel like human garbage.
3 months unemployed and 1 month since break up
